correctness.rationale: Logarithmic cross-ratio reduces exactly to a ratio of coordinate quotients. Normalized independent exponentials give independent unequal-rate exponential variables. Conditioning on their minimum, integration by parts and the beta recurrence establish the integral and sharp maximum. The logarithm of each product factor has strictly negative second derivative, giving the global strict majorization ordering. Dominated convergence proves the exact short-radius coefficient. Extreme-value bounds for exponential maxima and the exact exponential law for the scaled minimum establish the Gumbel limit with the stated centering and no independence assumption. The packaged checker verifies derived formulas and independent numerical examples, but the full proof is analytical.
